turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you help me draft a response to that internal email about the new AI integration roadmap?
Sure. Do you want to emphasize the technical benefits or the strategic risks?
Definitely the risks. I need to push back on this. Matthew Berman criticized the decision to enter the AI race as a hubristic gamble launched from a private company Slack.
Got it. I will frame the draft around that perspective.
Also, did you see the weather for next week? I might need to reschedule the outdoor team lunch.
Yes, it looks like rain. Want me to look for indoor venues?
No, just keep the email draft focused. Don't mention the lunch yet.
